converterParity.scope: valid catalog-shaped fixture and actual v0.9 message schema only; not full catalog/UI parity

conclusion: Constrained-container early rejection prevents child parsing and async child dispatch in these probes. Unbounded/nested/recursive probes retain their error reporting at one fixed input size. These counts do not establish an exploit, superlinear resource amplification, admitted-app vulnerability, or vulnerability of published Zod4. No production patch or complete UI/schema parity is established.

publishedZod4.source: existing disposable npm-ci copy of production-plugin lock

upstream.mechanism: Reject oversized explicitly constrained array/set/map before child parsing. Unbounded containers intentionally unchanged. Candidate is a three-site ESM mechanism probe, not a complete source/CJS/ESM distribution.

advisory.description: Zod schema-validation library through 4.6.5 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows attackers to exhaust memory by submitting a large array to an application using an array schema without a length constraint. Attackers can exploit the handleArrayResult parse logic in $ZodArray, which accumulates every validation issue for each failing element with no cap or early termination, causing the process to allocate excessive issue objects and crash due to out-of-memory conditions.
advisory.summary: Zod can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections

provenance.licenseDisposition: No third-party runtime source shipped here. Any future patch/reuse must preserve Zod MIT, A2UI Apache-2.0, converter ISC, and applicable renderer markdown notices.

boundaries.actualA2uiProbe: Actual published v0.9 A2uiMessageSchema with invalid component values; NOT the complete app admission pipeline. Counts include union wrapper issues. No RSS, timing, crash, exploit or scaling measurement.
boundaries.publishedZod4Probe: Uses published parser with a reconstructed analogous message schema, NOT a working A2UI/Zod4 migration.
boundaries.recursiveProbe: Synthetic parser-only recursive schema. Legacy workspace.inspect rejects FunctionCall keys and nesting over 20 before its main A2UI parse. This is not evidence of admitted recursive FunctionCall exposure.
boundaries.compatibility: Actual ChoicePicker schema accepts 65 options before and after candidate. A new blanket 64-option cap would change that compatibility. Existing valid fixture and sampled converter parity are not full visual/schema parity.
boundaries.runtime: No installed dependency, live BB/config/state, provider or browser execution changed.
